fullAuditRegeneration.unchanged: all 915 rows, 863 groups, disposition counts, issue counts, raw and qualified counts, and every row-content fingerprint

rootCause: The corpus fingerprint bound each referenced source's last_sync_at. That column is one row per publisher and is advanced by any pipeline that commits rows from that publisher, including Pulse news ingest and Wikidata fact refreshes that never touch an election. The audit's qualification never reads it: a source's sync time is only a fallback for an event statement without its own retrieval time, and statements.retrieved_at is NOT NULL.

publicSurfaces.reason: Reader and API election surfaces (queries.ts, queries-legislature.ts, factbook/legislature.ts, load-atlas-data.ts) gate each row on its own content fingerprint, which never included source sync times. All 915 match, so every audited row that was public on 2026-07-12 remains public. Only the offline audits (audit:source-coverage:live, audit:election-corpus:live) read the corpus fingerprint.

decision: Neither regenerate the 2026-07-12 audit nor treat a writer as faulty. Regeneration would only bind the new timestamps until the next Pulse ingest that carries an IPU election breaks it again. Bind source identity and license, not sync time (APR-D175).

notInScope.pulseIngestRunLedger: All 98 failed pulse.v2.ingest runs since 2026-08-15 (93 partial, 5 handler exceptions) are recorded with rows_written 0 and no freshness sources, although partial runs committed raw events and advanced source freshness (for example 2 IPU and 2 HRW rows on 2026-09-25). This is a separate run-ledger reporting gap, not an election-audit defect, tracked as PLT-032.
